messages:
mohammed-a: Hey payroll  I relocated from San Francisco to Toronto on 2027-03-10 and updated Workday. My 3/31 paycheck still shows full US federal + FICA withholding and no Canadian deductions (CPP/EI). Im unsure whether I should expect a W-2, a Canadian T4, or both for 2027. Can payroll advise?

jen-people-ops: @mohammed-a thanks for reporting. @samir-payroll and @intl-tax can you advise next steps and what docs you need?

payroll-bot: Created ticket PR-2027-055: "US->Canada midyear relocation & payroll reporting - Mohammed A (emp 56901)" assigned to samir-payroll.

samir-payroll: Thanks. Quick overview: there are two common setups for cross-border moves: 1) employee moved onto Canadian payroll (employer registers PAYROLL/CRA, withholds CPP/EI/Provincial tax)  then Canada reports a T4 for Canadian-source wages, and the US employer may still report US wages for the portion paid while US resident; 2) employee remains on US payroll but works in Canada  host-country registration may be required and CRA withholding could be necessary. We need to determine which path Redwood used.

intl-tax: Also note tax treaty and residency rules matter: if you became a Canadian resident for tax purposes, wages earned after your residency date are generally Canadian-source. The US-Canada treaty and foreign tax credit rules will determine double taxation relief.

mohammed-a: What docs do you need? I uploaded lease, new driver license, and my SIN to the ticket. Emp ID `56901`, last4 SSN `9987`.

samir-payroll: Good; that's helpful. Action plan: 1) confirm payroll country flag in Workday (US vs CA payroll) and effective pay dates; 2) extract ledger by workdate to allocate earnings pre/post-move; 3) check whether any FICA was withheld for post-move wages and whether Canadian CPP/EI should have been withheld instead; 4) propose correction (retro payroll adjustment, refund, or documentation). If Canadian payroll was activated midyear, we may issue both a W-2 (US wages) and a T4 (Canadian wages) or a single T4 if all wages moved to Canada, depending on processing.

casey-mgr: I confirm the relocation was approved and casey added a manager attestation to PR-2027-055.

samir-payroll: Example of potential reporting (illustrative only):

```
W-2 (US): Box 1 wages = 12,500.00 (earnings 1/1-3/9)
Box 12: FICA withheld for US period
T4 (Canada): Box 14 employment income = 22,300.00 (earnings 3/10-12/31)
CPP/EI withheld shown on T4 slips
```

samir-payroll: If FICA was withheld on Canadian wages in error, we'll review whether we can refund via payroll (depends on timing and IRS procedures for FICA refunds) or provide documentation for you to claim on your US return. If reporting boxes need change, we may issue a W-2c.

intl-tax: We'll run a residency test (arrival date, ties, 183-day rules) and confirm treaty positions; if needed, we can draft a memo for your CPA explaining split-year treatment and foreign tax credit options.

mohammed-a: Timeline? Im filing with a Toronto-based accountant in April.

samir-payroll: We'll aim to complete the ledger allocation and post proposed corrections in 7 business days after verifying docs. If corrections require forms (W-2c or T4 adjustments), those may take additional processing time. We'll update PR-2027-055 and post the final outcome here.

jen-people-ops: Action items recap: mohammad - confirm documents uploaded (done); samir - confirm Workday payroll flag & run allocation; intl-tax - run residency/treaty check and draft memo if needed. I'll follow up EOW. :white_check_mark:
